summary: Pull request https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/1035 at head d5fd3ed8cfd01beffb0fd7bc8ec7f7c101dfa866 makes `release-push.sh push-main` survive a same-package version-bump race: it now takes `<package-dir> <version>`, fetches main and rebases onto it between its five push attempts, resolves a conflict confined to the released package's package.json by setting .version to the released version and continuing the rebase, aborts and fails naming the paths on any other conflict, and states on every failure (log and job summary) that the publish, tag and GitHub release already succeeded and only the push to main is outstanding. Implemented test-first exactly per .legion/plan.json: the new .github/scripts/release-push.test.sh gave `Results: 10 passed, 12 failed` (exit 1) against the old script and `Results: 22 passed, 0 failed` (exit 0) against the new one, locally twice and on the GitHub runner in Tests run 34762283378 (all four jobs green; step `Test release scripts` in job test).

evidence.testBeforeFix: Results: 10 passed, 12 failed (exit 1): Case 1 failed all five checks — the old script died inside `git pull --rebase` under `set -e`, origin/main stayed at 1.0.1, clone left mid-rebase; Cases 2/2b failed the `::error::` naming and `rebase was aborted` checks; Case 3 failed the two message checks and the job-summary check; Case 4 and every exit-code/manifest-untouched check passed. Matches the plan's task 1 expectation exactly.
evidence.testAfterFix: Results: 22 passed, 0 failed / PASS: release-push.sh push-main (exit 0), run twice locally (deterministic; /tmp entry count 31137 before and after both runs) and on the runner (Tests run 34762283378, step `Test release scripts`, ~1 s).
evidence.case1ByHand: CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in packages/pkg/package.json → `Resolving the packages/pkg/package.json version-line conflict to v1.0.2` → `Successfully rebased and updated refs/heads/main.` → push accepted; origin/main log: `chore: release pkg v1.0.2 [skip ci]` over `chore: release pkg v1.0.1 [skip ci]` over `seed`; manifest .version 1.0.2.
evidence.negativeControl: Case 2 (README.md conflicting): exit 1, `::error::Rebasing the version-bump commit onto main (<sha>) conflicts in: README.md. Only a conflict confined to packages/pkg/package.json is resolved automatically. The release itself succeeded: …`, rebase aborted, origin/main manifest untouched at 1.0.0.
evidence.workflowWiring: Bun.YAML.parse of release.yaml lists exactly three push-main call sites: cli → packages/daemon, envoy_plugin → packages/envoy-plugin, pi_envoy → packages/pi-envoy, each with "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" (package dirs cross-checked against each job's `release-push.sh tag` call). pr-and-main.yaml parses; job test's steps begin actions/checkout@v5, Test release scripts, Setup Bun.
evidence.commitScope: `jj diff -r @- --stat` on the code commit: exactly the five paths above; release-push.test.sh is `new file mode 100755`; verify-envoy-release-workflow.sh is `deleted file mode 100755`; .omp/config.yml never committed.

trickyParts: `git rebase --continue` under the merge backend opens an editor and fails without a tty; `GIT_EDITOR=true` on that line is load-bearing, not cargo cult (plan concern; do not remove).

During a rebase stop, HEAD is main's side, so `git show HEAD:$manifest | jq '.version = $v'` keeps every other change main made to the manifest and rewrites only the version line — the one automatic rewrite the spec allows.
A resolution that leaves the commit empty (main already carries the identical bump) is dropped by `git rebase --continue` itself; no `--skip` branch is needed.
The conflict rule compares `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` to exactly `<package-dir>/package.json`; a manifest conflict alongside any other path (Case 2b) is aborted, not resolved.

After the path-scoped `jj split`, `jj git push` first answered `The working copy is stale` (another workspace's operation raced the shared op log; `Concurrent modification detected, resolving automatically` had appeared during the split). Repaired per docs/solutions/legion/shared-main-repo-hazards-for-concurrent-issue-workspaces.md Hazard 2: copied .omp/config.yml aside, `jj workspace update-stale`, restored the file; the chain, the code commit's five paths, and the bookmark were untouched. No undo/op restore/abandon was run.
deviations: Architect-directed addition beyond the plan: deleted .github/scripts/verify-envoy-release-workflow.sh in the same code commit. It targeted .github/workflows/release-envoy-and-plugin.yaml, which no longer exists, exited 1 unconditionally (`FAIL: .github/workflows/release-envoy-and-plugin.yaml not found`), and ran nowhere in CI or live docs; its only reference is docs/superpowers/plans/2026-04-12-fix-ci-docker-build-gating.md, a historical design record left unchanged. Named in the PR body as adjacent dead-script cleanup.
Waited for the PR checks through the Envoy subscription (notifications.github.sjawhar.legion.pr.1035.>) plus one `legion gh -- run watch`, which found the run already complete; no polling loop.
productionVerification: Nothing under packages/ changes, so merging triggers no release. The fix first runs for real on the next Release Packages run; the implementer's post-merge production check is that run's `Push version bump` step log (and, for a same-package race, the `Resolving the <manifest> version-line conflict to v<version>` line followed by a successful push).
